name: Neville L. Johnson
tagline: Top rated Entertainment & Sports attorney in Beverly Hills, California
side_practice_areas: Entertainment & Sports, Business Litigation, Media & Advertising
about: A veteran attorney with nearly half a century’s worth of experience, Neville L. Johnson is a pillar of leadership within his legal community and a beacon of guidance for up-and-coming legal professionals. A senior partner and co-founder of Johnson & Johnson LLP in Beverly Hills, California, he is focused on providing top-quality legal representation for clients pertaining to all aspects of entertainment law, as well as copyright infringement, guild disputes, right of publicity, defamation law, privacy law, class action litigation and many more.

Mr. Johnson obtained his license to practice law in California in 1975, after receiving his Juris Doctor from Southwestern Law School the same year. Since early in his career, he has been actively involved in helping progress the standard of client care of his industry to even greater heights through his practice. He understands what is important to his clients and fights tooth and nail to get them the respite and relief they deserve. Prior to attending law school, he completed his undergraduate studies in 1971 from the University of California, Berkeley.

A consummate professional through and through, Mr. Johnson helps keep his clients comfortable and provide them the support they need to get through difficult times of strife. His defense of myriad artists has been well-documented, as has his use of class action lawsuits against studio labels and record studios to release millions of dollars improperly withheld. Furthermore, a unanimous landmark privacy ruling from the California Supreme Court he obtained are now part of casebooks and taught in law schools across the nation.

Outside his law practice, Mr. Johnson maintains close affiliations with organizations such as the Beverly Hills Bar Association, the Los Angeles County Bar Association, the Association of Business Trial Lawyers, the Los Angeles Copyright Society, the American Board of Trial Advocates, the Consumer Attorneys of California and the Consumer Attorneys Association of America.
